description: What the local workers could not do, assembled for you to write yourself. Reads .sidecrew/runs/<id>/escalations.jsonl and returns each failed task with the exemplar and rules the worker had, plus both attempts' errors. Costs no worker tokens — it reads a finished run off disk. Two failures in here are NOT the test's fault and must not be rewritten as though they were: a stage_reached of 'mutation' means the mutation tool broke, and four mutation counts of zero mean nothing in that function could be mutated.

model.description: recorded as suggested_model; sonnet unless you say otherwise

run_id.description: defaults to the most recent run under .sidecrew/runs

name: sidecrew_escalate
